title: Prepare a model migration candidate
description: Transform an identified source model into a reviewable target-profile candidate using an explicit mapping, preserving source interpretation and exposing semantic changes, conformance results, and consumer compatibility limits.
inputs: Identified source model state and source/target profile definitions.
Explicit source-to-target mapping with recorded intentional semantic changes.
Declared current consumers and applicable compatibility criteria.
outputs: Identified migration candidate related to its source and mapping.
Transformation report, target conformance results, consumer-reconciliation results, and adoption-readiness limitations.
behavior: Check that the mapping applies to the identified source and target profiles.
Preserve entity identities and authoritative relationship meaning for representational transformations.
Record supplied intentional semantic changes and identify content not covered unambiguously by the mapping.
Assess the target candidate against its declared rules and reconcile declared consumers, reporting unassessed portions.
Keep source states and historical interpretation unchanged and leave adoption to controlled change authority.

failure_behavior.condition: A mapping is incomplete, ambiguous, or does not match the selected profiles.
failure_behavior.outcome: Identify unmapped content or mismatched selection; do not silently discard or invent definitions.

failure_behavior.condition: Transformation creates conflicting identities, references, or target-rule violations.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report the affected candidate subjects and withhold readiness for adoption.

failure_behavior.condition: A required consumer check cannot complete.
failure_behavior.outcome: Keep the candidate explicitly unresolved for adoption and expose the unassessed consumer.

failure_behavior.condition: Candidate preparation fails or is abandoned.
failure_behavior.outcome: Preserve the source state and report that no completed migration candidate has been established.

sources.basis: IR-005 / SR-015 confirms explicit migration-candidate preparation, reusing SR-012 interpretation and SR-013 conformance checking.

Propose MOD-003 as the single accountable architectural responsibility for the existing behavior. This allocation preserves the Function definition and does not establish implementation or completed interface/AR coverage outside the IR-001 pilot.
